name: @careops/contract
description: The committed API contract: OpenAPI documents regenerated from the reference API (Go-T01) and the black-box conformance suite every backend must pass (Go-T04+).

scripts.check: bun run generate && git diff --exit-code -- . && test -z "$(git status --porcelain .)"
scripts.test: if [ -z "$CONTRACT_BASE_URL" ]; then echo 'conformance suite: skipped — set CONTRACT_BASE_URL (+ CONTRACT_TARGET) or run the CI conformance steps'; else bun test; fi
